limitations: The source is internally inconsistent about this case's MRI follow-up age: Table 1 says 1 year, while the Results paragraph and Figure 7d say 6 months. The candidate preserves both as text and does not select one or assert that two separate scans occurred.

The case label comes from Table 1 and is within-article only. The Results describe one 288-hour CA/JV long-term survivor, but do not provide an external persistent animal identifier or an animal-level raw imaging dataset.
This is one MRI summary, not a comprehensive developmental assessment. The paper itself qualifies long-term neurologic conclusions because follow-up and ovine neurologic assessment are limited.

The article's correction addresses an omitted patent disclosure, not the MRI timing discrepancy. The public supplementary-material listing contains movies and a peer-review file, not a row-level postnatal imaging table.
